channel.title: ranwhat releases
channel.description: What each release of ranwhat added and fixed: the coding agents it reads, the rules it gained, and what it got wrong before.

item.title: ranwhat 0.6.0: Twenty coding agents, accounts and a Claude Code hook
item.description:
• check, watch and clean read Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, OpenCode, Continue, Aider and Goose too, twenty coding agents in all, each from the history it keeps on disk. Windsurf is read from the plaintext transcripts its Cascade hook writes.
  • New: ranwhat login links a machine to an optional account at account.ranwhat.com. It prints a code to type at ranwhat.com/device, signed in, and the machine gets a token of its own for update. ranwhat whoami says whose a token is, and ranwhat logout revokes the machine’s token and deletes it. Nothing that runs locally needs an account.
  • New: ranwhat reach lists the MCP servers your agents are configured with and what each runs or connects to, flags a secret written inline or a package fetched at no fixed version, and lists the credential files no Claude Code deny rule covers. It writes nothing.
  • New: ranwhat hook install adds an opt-in Claude Code hook, so a call watch would rate high or critical waits for your yes before it runs. It judges on your machine and sends nothing.
  • check, watch and clean take --fail-on SEVERITY, which exits 3 when anything at or above it is found, and --sarif PATH for code scanning. The repository’s action.yml runs them in GitHub Actions.
  • keep in clean’s review is remembered, so a value you keep is not reported again.
  • The bundled catalogue rates 204 scopes across twelve providers, up from 104, taking in the 100 the Plus feed added after 0.5.0.
  • On a terminal, scan, live and update --status may add one dim line about the Plus feed, never with --json. RANWHAT_NO_HINTS=1 turns it off.
  • watch flags aws s3 rb as a cloud delete.

item.title: ranwhat 0.5.0: Twelve coding agents
item.description:
• check, watch and clean read twelve coding agents, each from where it keeps its history: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, Grok Build, Droid, Kimi Code, Kimi CLI, Pi, Muse Code and OpenClaw.
  • New: ranwhat sources lists every agent and where it looked. --source ID reads one agent, and --path ID=PATH reads one from somewhere else.
  • clean knows each value by a salted fingerprint, so masking it once masks every copy, including one another program wrote with different escaping.
  • Agents’ databases, such as Codex’s thread index and OpenClaw’s, are searched for secrets read only, and the report says how to remove one in the agent itself.
  • On Windows, suggested commands are quoted to paste into cmd or PowerShell.

item.title: ranwhat 0.4.0: Sharper watch and clean
item.description:
• watch spots a local file sent off the machine: piped or posted to curl, wget or nc, including through head, gzip, jq or sed.
  • watch reads what the shell really runs inside quotes, $'...' and a wrapped shell, and ranks deleting your home directory critical however it is spelled, \rm included.
  • watch masks the secrets in the commands it quotes, and check masks in its watch section every secret its clean section found.
  • Reads the transcripts that subagents write.
  • Fewer false alarms: placeholders, settings constants and AWS ARNs read as what they are, not as secrets.
  • clean and watch stay linear in time on hostile input, such as a megabyte of crafted text or one enormous shell command.

item.title: ranwhat 0.3.0: One command for both, and a faster clean
item.description:
• New: ranwhat check runs watch and clean in one read-only pass. It changes nothing; masking stays a choice you make in clean.
  • clean went from 89 seconds to 2.1 on a 39 MB transcript, with the same findings. It no longer searches pasted screenshots, which cannot hold a credential.
  • Output fits your terminal’s width, and NO_COLOR is honoured.

item.title: ranwhat 0.2.1: Commands you can run
item.description:
• Run through uvx, the overview suggests uvx ranwhat demo, because a bare ranwhat is not on your PATH there.
  • The capability catalogue covers HubSpot, Discord, GitLab, Atlassian, Microsoft Graph, Sentry and Shopify.

item.title: ranwhat 0.2.0: A catalogue that can be refreshed
item.description:
• ranwhat update refreshes the capability catalogue from ranwhat’s feed, for Plus subscribers once Plus opens. It sends the subscription token and nothing else.
  • Without a feed every command still runs on the catalogue bundled with the release, and a damaged cache falls back to it.

item.title: ranwhat 0.1.1: A first run that answers
item.description: • A bare ranwhat prints what each command does and where to start, instead of a usage error.

item.title: ranwhat 0.1.0: First release
item.description:
• watch reads what Claude Code and OpenClaw ran and surfaces the irreversible actions worth knowing about.
  • clean finds credentials left in Claude Code’s transcripts and masks them when you ask.
  • scan and live score what an agent’s credentials allow, and demo shows a scan on an example.
